steps.speaker: Familiar Voice
steps.content: Reject it, Hypatia. You can do this.
It's a voice she knows. At first, she feels a surge of disbelieving joy. Then, as the recognition truly registers, it crumbles into overwhelming confusion.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Mr. Rust...? Is that really you?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Or... is this just another illusion...
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's a catastrophe tear zone... If we hide in there, we might just lose them for good.
[Exit flashback]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I failed again. I led everyone into danger... I harmed Margaret, and now I've hurt you as well...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Or perhaps...

Everything before her hovers between illusion and reality. Wails of grief tangle with manic laughter; countless hands claw at her even as they try to pull her close. Some belong to those she has hurt and failed. Others are phantoms she has desperately begged for help.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's because I've made no progress... because I still long to rely on someone... that's why these visions keep appearing...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'm sorry. I...

steps.speaker: Rust?
steps.content: Why mistake me for a ghost? I'm very much alive.

steps.speaker: Rust?
steps.content: Come on, now. Pull yourself together. A Mania-born hallucination wouldn't be this cheerful, would it? Listen to your master, open your eyes.
That light, cheerful voice cuts through the cacophony of madness like a clean blade. Slowly, Hypatia's unfocused gaze sharpens.
The legendary agent is indeed standing before her, wearing his characteristic, casual smile.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: See? I told you so.
Rust is alive, seemingly unaffected by the contamination seeping from him. If anything, this hostile environment seems to energize him.

Whatever had been haunting Hypatia has been pushed back, now cowering at the edges of the darkness. These entities fear him. They don't dare draw closer, as if a single step would see them torn apart and assimilated into his form.
He has grown stronger. More formidable than she'd ever imagined. Problems she cannot solve, he always dispatches with ease. Should that make her glad?
Though her relief is short-lived. Another sharp, clarifying pain cuts through her. As reality fully reasserts itself, the true scale of her failures settles in, heavy and inescapable.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...The pigeon is destroyed. Something has happened to Ms. Margaret...
Hypatia raises her trembling hands, turning them over to reveal the scorch marks on her palms. They are the final, desperate testimony of Margaret's avatar, its last warning to her.
And in her own consuming fear, she had missed it completely.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: She was in such danger, and I still insisted on keeping the connection open. I led them right to her... didn't I?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Hah... Here I go again. Always the same... I miscalculated the conditions of the tear zone, underestimated Fraser's ruthlessness, misjudged the sentiments of the farlanders... If I hadn't stubbornly pushed to go to Furor, you and Ms. Margaret would never have fallen into their trap!
She buries her face in her guilt-marked hands. The Society's sorcery is unnecessary now. Beneath the relentless tide of truth, the scholar's composure shatters like a dam, broken beyond repair.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Responsibility...? All I've inherited is the Campbells' arrogance. Nothing but pride... Who did I think I was? Without others' guidance, what have I ever truly accomplished?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Every stubborn choice I made... every single one was wrong. If I had just listened to you and left as told, none of this would have happened. How could I have been so blind until now...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Tell me what to do. Please! I swear I'll listen this time. I won't act recklessly again!

She clutches the hem of Rust's clothes with desperate force, like a drowning person clinging to the last solid thing in a raging sea. He is all she has left in her world, and she is terrified—terrified of misstepping again.
Rust watches her quietly. A long moment passes before he releases a slow sigh.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...I should say something comforting now. But I can't, Hypatia...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: This is as far as I can take you.

A red fissure tears open from Rust's collar, twisting upward before blooming outward like a grotesque flower. Beneath it churns a deep, malevolent chaos. And within that void, a single golden eye snaps open, its surface inscribed with shifting runes.
The hideous orb twitches, convulsing as it focuses, and it locks directly onto Hypatia's gaze. Instantly, she remembers.
This was the secret shared between Adelaide and his suspicious "friends"—a symbol that filled her with equal parts revulsion and primal terror.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is... the Underground sorcery?!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: When did it take hold? How was this done? Who was it... No, why didn't any of us sense it?
[Flashback]
(Flashback to the Day 2 ending scene where the Undergrounder assassinated the Luminaris representative)
[End of Flashback]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...! It was that moment...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But it shouldn't hold power like this... With this degree of corruption, your body will—
The fissures expand, splitting Rust's skin like a series of smiles that don't belong to him, each grinning mouth a gateway to a far larger, more terrible entity.
The prolonged battle has woken it. The residual contamination in the area answers the call, shrieking as it flows into the host's increasingly fractured body.
—The Black Ring, long thought perished, has awoken within Rust. With absolute will, it turns against its vessel, violently pulling him back toward the abyss.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No... <size=52>NO!!</size>

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What should I do? Tell me what I must do! Please... I beg you!
Rust looks down. He tries to move, but his body isn't answering.
He lifts his head, finds Hypatia, and manages an apologetic smile.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Mmm... there's something important. Do me a favor: survive through this tear zone and find that "contact" I mentioned. Ask him to pass on a message. Tell that person back in the city: I...
He pauses for a moment.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Heh... never mind. If I actually left some final words, he'd probably beat me senseless.
steps.female_content: Heh... never mind. If I actually left some final words, she'd never forgive me.

steps.content: His smile is now edged with quiet irony. Noting Hypatia's desperate, shaking refusal, he falls silent. With visible effort, he raises his hand and lays it softly on her shoulder, the touch meant to calm the storm of her fear.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...You don't need to do anything. At this point, it's irreversible. All of this is of my own making.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: This body has a... peculiar resonance with the Black Ring. It reacts unpredictably in environments with strong Black Ring effects. I knew the risk, yet I still chose to come to Fraser, gambling like a desperate man... because I, too, had something I absolutely had to do.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Accepting Margaret's request, agreeing to accompany you to Furor, venturing into this tear zone... these were all my choices as well. I made them because I was intrigued by the possibilities you spoke of, and because... in you, I see who I once was.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I understand the weight you carry. It's far too heavy for a child your age.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Huh...?
As he falls silent, Margaret's words from the start of the mission come back to him. Whatever her motives, he has to admit she reads people better than he ever could.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Heh, calling you "a child" was condescending. You are an exceptional scholar. Perhaps even the kind of talent this land has been waiting for. I want to help you go further.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Walk away from this charade. Set down the burdens that were never yours to carry. Find someone who can truly guide you. People like that do exist; I've even met one myself.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: He would protect you, cherish you, shield you from suffering you should never have to endure, heal your wounds, and guide you down the path you're truly meant to walk. I genuinely hope you find someone like that.
steps.female_content: She would protect you, cherish you, shield you from suffering you should never have to endure, heal your wounds, and guide you down the path you're truly meant to walk. I genuinely hope you find someone like that.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...But I can already sense it. You probably won't choose that "correct" path.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: We've both trudged through our "mistakes" for too long. We're too stubborn. Incapable of letting go.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: We're... the same?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Heh... indeed. If you're determined to continue down this road, stubbornly resolved to see it through to the end... then allow me, as one who has walked it, to offer a few pieces of advice.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Argh!!

The hands resting on Hypatia's shoulders suddenly shove her away. In the same moment, every wound across Rust's body ruptures at once. Contamination spills outward, swelling into a chaotic rift that yawns open around him. Half of his form is swallowed into the void; the other half twists violently, pulled into impossible shapes.
Rust doesn't fight it. From within the devouring chaos, his eyes find hers, and he smiles.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: First, objectively analyze the situation before you. As a scholar, you should excel at this. Recognize which outcomes are inevitable and which actions are futile. You cannot save me.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Understand reality. Accept loss. This is... <color=#fb9259>Lesson One</color>.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No! You'll be—

Hypatia lunges forward to grab him, but the space between them warps and stretches. Each desperate reach only widens the gap, leaving her grasping at air as Rust is slowly pulled into the rift. He doesn't reach back.
He only watches her, this stubborn, bewildered aftercomer, soon to walk the path he leaves behind.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Now, the Mania here may create illusions—taking my form, Margaret's, or others'—to condemn you, attack you, hold you responsible for all that has happened... Do not panic. You will face far more of this in the future.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Once you leave this place, the path will not grow easier. Ahead, more people will blame you, make you their scapegoat. Those who hate you will slander your name. Even those you love may refuse to understand you.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: If you have no time to defend yourself, cannot clear your name, and are unable to simply let go... if you remain stubborn and refuse to yield, then grit your teeth and endure it all. Until your stubbornness becomes second nature.
The Aurum Secretum she releases is swallowed by the rift as if called home. She stands helpless. Even the ravenous contamination denies her, forced back by the relentless push of Rust's own will.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You will grow accustomed to receiving no praise, to disappointing others' expectations. One day, you will realize that forgiveness and redemption are beyond reach. You will continue to lose things along the way, with only weakness and failure as your companions. And you can only endure.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: But after enduring long enough, you will see... that pain is just pain. You can bear it. We have already fallen into the abyss, but once you grow accustomed to it, even the abyss cannot stop you from moving forward.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: When that time comes, if you still haven't changed your mind, then pick yourself up and continue with what you "must" do. Only then will your "stubbornness" truly have meaning.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: —That's it for Lesson Two.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But I'm all alone... I don't even know which way to go! I need someone to tell me what's right!

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: This isn't scientific research, Hypatia. No one will guide you, and "correct" exists only in delusion. This path likely has no endpoint, and you must walk it alone.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Living is its own kind of hell. Welcome to consciousness, <color=#fb9259>Survivor</color>.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ah...
Rust watches her near-panicked face and feels something long forgotten: a pang of regret.
Should he have been less flexible? Should he have been firmer and sent her away, to that one who could truly "guide" her—something he could never do?
If he had tempered his recklessness, listened to his advice to be more cautious... could he have avoided this? He's been scolded. He's even promised him to be more careful with his own life.
steps.female_content: If he had tempered his recklessness, listened to her advice to be more cautious... could he have avoided this? He's been scolded before. He's even promised her to be more careful with his own life.

steps.content: But... what good would it have done? He could never have convinced her anyway. This "apprentice" of his is, after all, too much like him.
Chaos rises over him in waves, pulling him under. His voice grows thin, filled with both regret and final guidance.
(Rust gradually disappears)

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: That is all the "wisdom" I can scrape from the bottom of the barrel, as one who has walked this path. I hope it helps a little when you stubbornly persist on your journey. As for the rest...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: The rest is just useless blessings.
But she doesn't want blessings.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I wish... that since fate is fickle, it cannot always be cruel. May it grant you a few opportunities, and perhaps a little protection.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I wish you could meet a few more friends to walk with you for a while, to support you. Best of all, bonds strong enough to pull you back from the edge...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No... Don't go...
Correct her one more time. Scold her if he has to. Just... someone, please, tell her how to move forward. Show her the way again.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: If you remain this stubborn, forever marching forward, then I wish you...
Hypatia finally breaks through the barrier and lunges forward, but her hands only close on empty air.
The rift has sealed, taking everything she wanted to hold onto. The bewildered scholar passes through the last fading imprint of him, stumbles, and finally collapses to her knees in the mud.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I wish you would reach your journey's end, as you desire...
His last words dissolve like ghosts, leaving only echoes to linger in the tear zone.
[Filter dims 2s]
She is all alone now.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What... what should I do...
[Black Screen]
No monsters, no direction. Only darkness lies ahead... An immense emptiness envelops Hypatia like a shroud, but she must move forward—alone, and regardless of what awaits.
